comparison.objective: Reorient and clamp an angle-grinder guard toward the operator.
comparison.physical_skill: Open a clamp lever, rotate a constrained guard around the spindle, and re-clamp while avoiding the disc.
comparison.success_condition: Guard direction and lever angle within tolerances, grinder undisturbed, tools/hands clear; unsafe contact or forced rotation caps credit.
comparison.reason: Articulated safety-guard adjustment tests clamp release and angular positioning, not granular screening.
